# Coppergate

> Set a budget. Agents war. Survivors ship. Coppergate runs autonomous engineering agents inside a spend cap — contenders compete, fitness and evidence decide, you review what ships.

Coppergate is an open-source (MIT) multi-agent arena for engineering work. Selection pressure (fitness relative to spend) ranks qualifying paths; weak agents lose budget and exit; survivors are prepared as pull/merge requests for human review.

Website: https://www.coppergate.ai
Repository: https://github.com/coppergateai/coppergate
Contact: hello@coppergate.ai
